about:
Hello! I am **AKHILESH A**, an enthusiastic and dedicated **Full Stack Web Developer** pursuing my **B.Tech in Information Technology** at **SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli** (2024 - 2028).

I have a strong passion for developing responsive, accessible, and scalable web applications from scratch. With hands-on experience in both frontend and backend development—spanning **React.js**, **JavaScript**, **MongoDB**, **SQL**, and **Python**—I love transforming ideas into clean, functional, and user-friendly digital experiences.

Having recently completed an intensive **3-month online Full Stack Web Development Internship**, I am constantly exploring modern web technologies, strengthening my problem-solving capabilities in **C, C++, and Python**, and deploying applications using platforms like **Vercel**.

When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring new developer tools, learning emerging frameworks, and working on creative personal projects. I am currently open to new opportunities, collaborations, and exciting projects!
